source_duty_flags.duty: Opening: bodily faculties require spirits for their operation; spirit is described as subtle/airy bodily substance generated through heat, not automatically the rational soul.
source_duty_flags.first_status: UNMET: only the bodily-spirit kind is named; opening faculties, heat, subtle/airy body and effects are not written.
source_duty_flags.whole_status: INCOMPLETE: bodily-spirit name only; source opening faculties, heat generation, subtle/airy body, channels and effects absent.

source_duty_flags.duty: Physicians-attributed liver account: heat works on blood, boiling generates smoke, veins purify it into natural spirit; that spirit then makes blood subtle and moves/sends it to limbs. Preserve the mediator acting on its earlier source medium; no measured feedback law is supplied.
source_duty_flags.first_status: UNMET: no liver/blood/smoke/generation or subsequent blood action written.
source_duty_flags.whole_status: PARTIAL: R9 supplies heat acting on blood in liver; physicians attribution, boiling/smoke, carrier generation, purification, natural naming and blood redistribution absent.

source_duty_flags.duty: The same spirit travels toward the heart, is further purified through the described movement/smiting, and is called vital. Its spread to limbs and the works it governs remain distinct from a mere change of label.
source_duty_flags.first_status: PARTIAL: refinement at HEART written with shared carrier; movement/smiting, comparative further refinement, vital naming, spread and governed works remain unmet.
source_duty_flags.whole_status: PARTIAL unchanged: first HEART refinement; further/comparative state, smiting, travel, vital naming/spread absent.

source_duty_flags.duty: Left-heart artery divides into downward and upward branches; downward supply serves lower limbs, upward divides into right arm, left arm and brain/higher parts. Retain all named branches and their recipients without assuming any corresponding manuscript picture/count.
source_duty_flags.first_status: UNMET: no branch or recipient construction.
source_duty_flags.whole_status: UNMET: all left-heart branching, named branches and recipients remain unwritten.

source_duty_flags.duty: The same spirit enters brain cavities, is further refined and changed into animal spirit, generated in the foremost cavity. Some spreads to sensation limbs; some remains for common sense/common wit/imagination. No assertion that all incoming spirit is consumed or that one indivisible parcel occupies every branch.
source_duty_flags.first_status: PARTIAL: refinement at BRAIN written with shared carrier; entry, cavities, relative subtlety/change, animal naming and partial distribution/retention remain unmet.
source_duty_flags.whole_status: PARTIAL: first BRAIN refinement plus generic portion retained in brain cavities and generic portion distributed to sensation limbs; animal naming/change, foremost origin, comparative subtlety and retained faculties remain absent. No identity/complement relation between portions asserted.

source_duty_flags.duty: The account proceeds to the Logistic middle cavity for intellect/understanding; after informing intellect, it passes to memory bearing prints of likeness made in the other cavities and deposits them there. The carrier, carried representations, their provenance and storage destination are different roles.
source_duty_flags.first_status: PARTIAL: bearer, separate likeness-prints and memory deposition written; Logistic/intellect-before-memory, provenance in other cavities and precise passage duties remain unmet.
source_duty_flags.whole_status: PARTIAL unchanged: carrier/likeness-print/memory deposition; Logistic/intellect and likeness origin absent.

source_duty_flags.duty: From hindmost brain parts it passes through spinal marrow to moving sinews, for voluntary movement in lower parts. Keep this continuation as well as the memory sequence; memory deposition is not declared the terminal destination of all spirit.
source_duty_flags.first_status: UNMET: no hindmost brain/spinal marrow/sinews/voluntary-movement continuation.
source_duty_flags.whole_status: UNMET: hindmost brain, spinal marrow, moving sinews and voluntary movement unwritten.

source_duty_flags.duty: Closing explicitly calls it one and the same spirit named natural/vital/animal by liver/heart/head working. This is asserted continuity across processing/naming descriptions, not unchanged chemical composition or identity of every distributed portion.
source_duty_flags.first_status: PARTIAL: generic carrier reference is preserved across two sites; full natural/vital/animal naming and liver/head distinction are not yet written.
source_duty_flags.whole_status: PARTIAL: explicit generic c references plus identity-marked SAME references; no full three site-name account.

source_duty_flags.duty: The Augustine-attributed qualification denies that this spirit is the rational soul and calls it its car/instrument. Through it the soul is joined to the body; without its service no soul act is perfectly exercised in the body. Impairment/hindrance is then linked to disrupted accord and inhibited works, with historical mental-disorder examples. Preserve attribution and perfectly; no modern diagnosis or universal medical fact is established.
source_duty_flags.first_status: UNMET: non-soul/instrument, attribution, perfectly qualified dependency, impairment and examples not written.
source_duty_flags.whole_status: PARTIAL: R6 necessary service for all perfect bodily soul activities, R7 carrier-as-instrument direction, R8 explicit nonidentity. Augustine attribution, car comparison, joining, impairment/accord loss and examples absent.
